description: The public market-event feed: every headline Muhabbit's wire published, newest first. Each item is an entry of the hash-chained public record with three clocks in UTC ms (source_at = publisher, detected_at = our ingest, published_at = our publication), focus tags, a category and impact 0-100. Covers exchange listings, US CPI, jobs and Fed, crypto, macro and tech. Exchange security alert headlines appear here too (suspected ones start with 'Unconfirmed:'; their evidence is in muhabbit_alerts). Page with next_cursor. (Free: no credentials needed.)

categories.description: Keep only these categories: listings (exchange listings), cpi, jobs, fed (US macro prints), crypto, macro, tech

min_impact.description: Keep events with impact at or above this (0-100). Above 0 drops events whose impact is unknown.

name: muhabbit_events
title: Public market-event feed
